patches.replace:
redis:
    image: redis:8.8-alpine
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes"]
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped
  # @praxis:services

worker:
    build:
      context: .
    environment:
      DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE: config.settings.development
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: local-development-only-secret-key
      DATABASE_HOST: postgres
      DATABASE_NAME: app
      DATABASE_USER: app
      DATABASE_PASSWORD: app
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    command: ["celery", "-A", "config", "worker", "--loglevel=INFO", "--concurrency=2"]
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
  # @praxis:services

worker:
    build:
      context: .
    entrypoint: ["/worker"]
    environment:
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
  # @praxis:services
